author: Mark Twain (Samuel L. Clemens)
title: Life on the Mississippi
edition: Boston: James R. Osgood and Company, 1883, with more than 300 illustrations, as shown by the photographed title page in Project Gutenberg eBook245 HTML (https://www.gutenberg.org/files/245/245-h/images/titlepage.jpg). Original English prose transcription; line wrapping is joined within paragraphs. Original paragraph boundaries, dialect, punctuation, underscore emphasis and transcribed footnotes are retained. Twain’s own footnotes, which Project Gutenberg sets inline in bracketed markup, are given as in the 1883 print: a superscript ¹ marks the citing word, and the note follows that paragraph as its own block beginning “¹”. No modern introduction or digitizer boilerplate is included. The library text runs from the prefatory extract “The ‘Body of the Nation’” through Chapters 1–60 and Appendices A–D; the table of contents is omitted. A note with no citing word in the transcription (Chapter 40, “Illustrations of it thoughtlessly omitted by the advertiser”, which the file sets as its own paragraph) follows the paragraph before it, beginning “¹”, with its own paragraphs kept.

rights.basis: The associated photographed title page identifies this as the Boston Osgood1883 printing, outside the US copyright term in2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies eBook245 as public domain in the USA. The dated title-page image was visually checked on2026-10-07.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (pglaf mirror of ebook 245). Removed the Gutenberg header, footer, licence, producer credit and table of contents; converted each inline “{footnote [...]}” to a superscript numeral (¹, ² within one paragraph) at the citing word and placed the note after its paragraph as its own block, dropping the transcription's “1.” note label; joined wrapped prose lines with single spaces; chapter numbers became level-2 headings with the chapter title as a level-3 heading, and the prefatory extract and appendix titles became level-2 headings. Underscore emphasis kept as in the file.
